question: What post-subagent completion or generic delivery/output hook contract should OpenClaw support, and what authority should plugins have to inspect child output, observe delivery, or mutate/suppress the announcement?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing payload fields, redaction, ordering, timeout/error behavior, auditability, and mutation authority creates a public plugin API and security boundary that automation should not lock in.

options.title: Generic Typed Delivery Boundary
options.body: Define one product-driven hook boundary for completion/output delivery, then make subagent completion use it with explicit redaction, fallback, timeout, and audit semantics.

options.title: Narrow Subagent Completion Hook
options.body: Add a subagent-specific hook at the pre-announcement seam, accepting that a later generic delivery model may need to supersede it.

options.title: Observation-Only Event
options.body: Expose only non-mutating completion metadata now and leave enrichment, suppression, and delivery-status recovery to separate delivery-policy work.

recommendation.title: Generic Typed Delivery Boundary
recommendation.body: Define one product-driven hook boundary for completion/output delivery, then make subagent completion use it with explicit redaction, fallback, timeout, and audit semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current product/API signal is the review closing the overlapping guard-hook PR, and recent commits touch the same subagent binding and delivery surface.
